policy: Media providers are isolated adapters. Do not modify TNT AI core provider code for Media-specific capabilities.
rules: Reuse stable TNT AI interfaces where capability already exists.
Add Media-only adapters under venture_foundry/media/providers for missing capabilities.
Never patch TNT AI core merely to support Media experiments.
Provider credentials must not be committed to project files.
Every generated asset must record provider, model, prompt/version, timestamp, and provenance.
